build_pacer_agent: build a PACER agent that combines beam search with partial re-ranking for dialogue generation
create_pacer_treesearch_mixin: create a PacerTreeSearchMixin subclass to override select_paths and modify logprobs with classifier scores
run_pacer_greedy_search: run PacerGreedySearch to generate tokens using greedy decoding with PACER re-ranking applied stochastically
review_pacer_modify_logprobs: review the modify_logprobs method that rescores top-k tokens using a classifier to predict character alignment
refactor_pacer_agent_mixin: refactor the PacerAgentMixin to customize the reranker class or adjust pacer_n_tokens and frequency ratio parameters
